description: In omega one, the set of all ordinals other than omega contains a club and belongs to the club filter, but is not ordinal-closed.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ClubsAndStationarySets.clubFilter_member_not_closed.{u_1} :
  ∃ A,
    A = {a | ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd a) < Ordinal.omega0 ∨ Ordinal.omega0 < ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd a)} ∧
      A ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.clubFilter (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.Carrier (Cardinal.aleph 1)) ∧
        ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.IsOrdinalClosed A
